evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 rising monotonically during growth from ~5.6 to 29.7 ppm despite stable Ar flow
Tube pressure creeping up 3.03 -> 3.28 Torr at constant 100 sccm Ar
MFC steady at ~100 sccm, so rise is not a flow change

args.missing_evidence: Response of O2/pressure to a brief Ar flow change or pump-down (leak-up test) would distinguish an air in-leak from exhaust restriction or outgassing.
